description.value: Bubby's Bicycle Service Ltd. is a full-service independent bike shop in Errington on central Vancouver Island, run by mechanic Chris. The shop offers a comprehensive repair menu from basic tune-ups to full overhauls, stocks parts from an extensive brand catalogue, and sells used and consignment bikes. A pickup-and-delivery service means cyclists who can't transport their bike can still get it serviced.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bubbysbikes.ca is fully accessible and provides strong evidence for most fields. The contact page explicitly states 'All service is by appointment. No drop-ins please.', which is the key fact shaping urgent-mechanical and walk-in assessments. The parts page lists brands including Basil (panniers/bags) and the repair page includes rack/fender installation, supporting a touring-parts finding. OSM name 'Bubby's Mechanic Service' differs from the website's consistent 'Bubby's Bicycle Service Ltd.' — flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Bubby's Mechanic Service' but the website consistently uses 'Bubby's Bicycle Service Ltd.' — OSM name may be outdated or informal.
OSM warning tag states 'Unit number required', suggesting the address at 1671 Grafton Avenue may be incomplete.
Appointment-only policy with no drop-ins may significantly limit usefulness for touring cyclists needing urgent roadside help.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active bike shop with repair services and parts retail on Vancouver Island. The appointment-only policy limits walk-in utility for touring cyclists but the phone/text contact and pickup service provide meaningful support options worth listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pickup and delivery service ('Can't fit your bike in your car? No problem! We can pick it up!') is a notable offering that partly compensates for the no-drop-in policy.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Parts page lists Basil (panniers/cycling bags) among carried brands; repair menu includes rack install and fender install, indicating relevant stock

wow_evidence: full-service independent bike shop... stocks parts from an extensive brand catalogue... pickup-and-delivery service
